items.author: Trump
items.text: I was just in Alaska launching the largest Energy Infrastructure Project in Alaska History— The Alaska LNG Project. This 50 Billion Dollar Infrastructure Investment from The Republic of Korea is part of their Trade and Investment Deal with me. I am also announcing today that my Commerce Secretary, Howard Lutnick, has secured an Offtake Commitment from Taiwan of between 70 to 80 Billion Dollars for Alaska LNG — That is 30% of the Pipeline for the next 20 years. This is the largest Offtake Agreement in History. On top of that, Taiwan has also agreed to Invest 4.4 Billion Dollars in Equity into t
items.summary_cn: Trump 宣布韩国向阿拉斯加LNG项目投资500亿美元，同时台湾承诺承购价值700亿至800亿美元天然气并投资44亿美元股权。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Massive Oil, Gas, and Mineral Exploration is getting ready to begin in our new and beautiful Greenland! There are Experts that are saying that the amount of easily available Oil is far greater than that of almost any land, anywhere in the World and, even more importantly, from a Security Purpose in the Defense and Offense of both the United States of America, and Europe, is second to none. Any future attack on the United States will have to come across Greenland, where our Defense will routinely knock down drones, missiles, or any other form of weapon not yet even conceived. It gives us time,
items.summary_cn: Trump 称格陵兰即将启动大规模石油、天然气和矿产勘探，并强调该地区对美欧军事安全的重要性。
